Fig 2:
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(patchwork)
library(ggrepel)

# ==========================================
# 1. CONFIGURATION
# ==========================================
input_file <- "/Users/Archibald/Documents/PhD/Chapter_1/Clusters/Master_Summary_SR_Cluster_Perch_and_Indices_Macro2.csv"
output_dir <- "/Users/Archibald/Documents/PhD/Chapter_1/plots/"

if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)

# We are only using Unsupervised Clusters for this plot
er_col_cluster <- "hier_euc_t0.7_br_noise_removed"

# Initial scales needed to pull in the raw data
initial_scales <- c("15_Second_Interval", "1_Minute_Interval", "15_Minute_Interval", "Site_Date", "Site")
# Scales used for final plotting
plot_scales <- c("15_Second_Interval", "1_Minute_Interval", "15_Minute_Interval", "Macro (~1 Hour)")
base_datasets <- c("PER", "STM_h", "STM_s_HTR", "STM_s_LTR")

theme_mee <- function() {
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5), 
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.background = element_blank(),
      legend.key = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5)
    )
}

# ==========================================
# 2. DATA PREP & EFFORT CALCULATION
# ==========================================
cat("Loading data...\n")
df <- read.csv(input_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

df_filtered <- df %>%
  filter(Dataset %in% base_datasets,
         Summary_Level %in% initial_scales) %>%
  mutate(Region = ifelse(grepl("PER", Dataset), "PER", "STM")) 

base_effort <- df %>%
  filter(
    (Dataset %in% c("PER", "STM_h", "STM_s_HTR") & Summary_Level == "15_Second_Interval") |
    (Dataset == "STM_s_LTR" & Summary_Level == "15_Minute_Interval")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Minute_Value = ifelse(Summary_Level == "15_Second_Interval", 0.25, 15),
    Target_Site_Date = sub("_[^_]+$", "", Grouping),
    Target_Site = sub("_[^_]+_[^_]+$", "", Grouping)
  )

effort_site_date <- base_effort %>%
  group_by(Dataset, Grouping = Target_Site_Date) %>%
  summarize(Effort_Minutes = sum(Minute_Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Summary_Level = "Site_Date")

effort_site <- base_effort %>%
  group_by(Dataset, Grouping = Target_Site) %>%
  summarize(Effort_Minutes = sum(Minute_Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Summary_Level = "Site")

effort_combined <- bind_rows(effort_site_date, effort_site)

# Merge efforts, then filter and rename Site/Site_Date
df_final <- df_filtered %>%
  left_join(effort_combined, by = c("Dataset", "Summary_Level", "Grouping")) %>%
  mutate(Effort_Minutes = replace_na(Effort_Minutes, 1)) %>%
  # Apply filtering rules for the Macro panel
  filter(
    Summary_Level %in% c("15_Second_Interval", "1_Minute_Interval", "15_Minute_Interval") |
    (Region == "STM" & Summary_Level == "Site") |
    (Region == "PER" & Summary_Level == "Site_Date")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Combine the remaining Site and Site_Date records into a single level
    Summary_Level = ifelse(Summary_Level %in% c("Site", "Site_Date"), "Macro (~1 Hour)", Summary_Level)
  )

# ==========================================
# 3. PLOT PREPARATION
# ==========================================
cat("Preparing plot data...\n")

# Set seed for reproducible jittering
set.seed(42)

sub_df <- df_final %>%
  mutate(
    ER = !!sym(er_col_cluster),
    
    # Dynamic Alpha based on density
    Alpha_Val = case_when(
      Summary_Level %in% c("Macro (~1 Hour)", "15_Minute_Interval") ~ 0.6,
      Summary_Level == "1_Minute_Interval" ~ 0.2,
      TRUE ~ 0.05 # For 15_Second_Interval
    ),
    
    # Selective Jittering: Only scramble the coordinates for the dense 15s/1m scales
    plot_ER = ifelse(Summary_Level %in% c("15_Second_Interval", "1_Minute_Interval"), 
                     jitter(ER, amount = 0.4), ER),
    plot_SR = ifelse(Summary_Level %in% c("15_Second_Interval", "1_Minute_Interval"), 
                     jitter(SR, amount = 0.4), SR)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(SR) & !is.na(ER))

# Lock in the factor order so the facets draw left-to-right
sub_df$Summary_Level <- factor(sub_df$Summary_Level, levels = plot_scales)

# Calculate Spearman's Rho and P-Values (Using True Data, not Jittered Data)
stats_df <- sub_df %>%
  group_by(Region, Summary_Level) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    df_sub <- .x
    if (nrow(df_sub) < 3) return(data.frame(rho = NA, pval = NA))
    
    ct <- cor.test(df_sub$ER, df_sub$SR, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
    
    p_val <- ct$p.value
    p_str <- if (p_val < 0.001) "< 0.001" else sprintf("= %.3f", p_val)
    
    data.frame(
      rho = ct$estimate,
      pval = p_str
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(rho)) %>%
  mutate(label = sprintf("\u03c1 = %.3f (p %s)", rho, pval))

# Calculate mathematically consistent coordinates for the floating labels
label_coords <- sub_df %>%
  group_by(Summary_Level) %>%
  summarize(
    max_x = max(ER, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_y = max(SR, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

stats_df <- stats_df %>%
  left_join(label_coords, by = "Summary_Level") %>%
  mutate(
    # Because limits start at 0, multiplying by a percentage guarantees perfect alignment
    plot_x = max_x * 0.03, # Exactly 3% from the left edge
    plot_y = ifelse(Region == "PER", max_y * 1.06, max_y * 1.04) # Exact vertical tiering
  )

# ==========================================
# 4. GENERATE AND EXPORT PLOT
# ==========================================
cat("Building 2x2 grid plot...\n")

p <- ggplot(sub_df) +
  
  # --- POINT LAYER 1: 15-Second Scale (All shapes) - Size 1.5 ---
  geom_point(data = filter(sub_df, Summary_Level == "15_Second_Interval"),
             aes(x = plot_ER, y = plot_SR, color = Region, shape = Dataset, alpha = Alpha_Val), 
             size = 1.5) +
             
  # --- POINT LAYER 2a: 1-Minute Scale for non-triangle shapes - Size 1.5 ---
  geom_point(data = filter(sub_df, Summary_Level == "1_Minute_Interval" & Dataset != "STM_s_HTR"),
             aes(x = plot_ER, y = plot_SR, color = Region, shape = Dataset, alpha = Alpha_Val), 
             size = 1.5) +
             
  # --- POINT LAYER 2b: 1-Minute Scale for STM_s_HTR (Triangles) - Size bumped to 2.5 ---
  geom_point(data = filter(sub_df, Summary_Level == "1_Minute_Interval" & Dataset == "STM_s_HTR"),
             aes(x = plot_ER, y = plot_SR, color = Region, shape = Dataset, alpha = Alpha_Val), 
             size = 2.5) +
             
  # --- POINT LAYER 3: 15-Minute Scale (Tripled Size) - Size 4.5 ---
  geom_point(data = filter(sub_df, Summary_Level == "15_Minute_Interval"),
             aes(x = plot_ER, y = plot_SR, color = Region, shape = Dataset, alpha = Alpha_Val), 
             size = 4.5) +
  
  # --- POINT LAYER 4: Macro Scales (Fixed Size 4.5 to match 15m scale) ---
  geom_point(data = filter(sub_df, Summary_Level == "Macro (~1 Hour)"),
             aes(x = plot_ER, y = plot_SR, color = Region, shape = Dataset, alpha = Alpha_Val),
             size = 6) +
  
  scale_alpha_identity() +
  
  # Colors
  scale_color_manual(name = "Region", values = c("PER" = "green4", "STM" = "darkorange2")) +
  
  # Shapes: PER is set to 16 but excluded via `breaks`, dropping it from the legend
  scale_shape_manual(
    name = "STM sub-datasets", 
    values = c("PER" = 16, "STM_h" = 16, "STM_s_HTR" = 17, "STM_s_LTR" = 15),
    breaks = c("STM_h", "STM_s_HTR", "STM_s_LTR") 
  ) +
  
  # TRENDLINE: Linear model for all Scales (Weights use True Effort_Minutes)
  geom_smooth(data = filter(sub_df, Summary_Level %in% plot_scales),
               aes(x = ER, y = SR, color = Region, weight = Effort_Minutes), 
               method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = TRUE, alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 1) +
               
  # Floating Stats with White Outline
  geom_text_repel(data = stats_df, 
                  aes(x = plot_x, y = plot_y, label = label, color = Region), 
                  hjust = 0, vjust = 1, direction = "y", 
                  point.padding = NA, 
                  bg.color = "white", bg.r = 0.15, 
                  segment.color = NA, size = 4, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +
  
  # Faceting: 2 columns x 2 rows creates exactly 4 panels
  facet_wrap(~ Summary_Level, ncol = 2, nrow = 2, scales = "free", 
             labeller = as_labeller(function(x) gsub("_", " ", x))) +
  
  # Force axes to start at (0,0) exactly
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) + 
  
  labs(
    title = "Unsupervised Clusters: Predictive Performance by Region",
    x = "Estimated Richness (Unsupervised Clusters)",
    y = "Observed Richness (SR)"
  ) +
  theme_mee() +
  
  # Legend Customization and Horizontal Formatting
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom", 
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.background = element_blank()
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 5, shape = 16, fill = NA), order = 1, nrow = 1),
    shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 4, color = "darkorange2"), order = 2, nrow = 1)
  )

output_path <- paste0(output_dir, "figure2_2.png")
ggsave(output_path, p, width = 10, height = 9, dpi = 300)
cat("Done! Saved plot to:", output_path, "\n")
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(patchwork)

# ==========================================
# 1. CONFIGURATION
# ==========================================
input_file <- "/Users/Archibald/Documents/PhD/Chapter_1/Clusters/Master_Summary_SR_Cluster_Perch_and_Indices_Macro.csv"
output_dir <- "/Users/Archibald/Documents/PhD/Chapter_1/plots/"

if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)

er_col_cluster <- "hier_euc_t0.7_br_noise_removed"

# Initial scales needed to pull the raw data before merging
initial_scales <- c("15_Second_Interval", "1_Minute_Interval", "15_Minute_Interval", "Site_Date", "Site")
# The actual 4 panels to loop through
plot_scales <- c("15_Second_Interval", "1_Minute_Interval", "15_Minute_Interval", "Macro (~1 Hour)")

base_datasets <- c("PER", "STM_h", "STM_s_HTR", "STM_s_LTR")

# Elegant, High-IF Journal Theme
theme_mee <- function() {
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5), 
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.background = element_blank(),
      legend.key = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5)
    )
}

# ==========================================
# 2. DATA PREP & EFFORT CALCULATION
# ==========================================
cat("Loading data...\n")
df <- read.csv(input_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

df_filtered <- df %>%
  filter(Dataset %in% base_datasets,
         Summary_Level %in% initial_scales) %>%
  mutate(Region = ifelse(grepl("PER", Dataset), "PER", "STM"))

base_effort <- df %>%
  filter(
    (Dataset %in% c("PER", "STM_h", "STM_s_HTR") & Summary_Level == "15_Second_Interval") |
    (Dataset == "STM_s_LTR" & Summary_Level == "15_Minute_Interval")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Minute_Value = ifelse(Summary_Level == "15_Second_Interval", 0.25, 15),
    Target_Site_Date = sub("_[^_]+$", "", Grouping),
    Target_Site = sub("_[^_]+_[^_]+$", "", Grouping)
  )

effort_site_date <- base_effort %>%
  group_by(Dataset, Grouping = Target_Site_Date) %>%
  summarize(Effort_Minutes = sum(Minute_Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Summary_Level = "Site_Date")

effort_site <- base_effort %>%
  group_by(Dataset, Grouping = Target_Site) %>%
  summarize(Effort_Minutes = sum(Minute_Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Summary_Level = "Site")

effort_combined <- bind_rows(effort_site_date, effort_site)

# Merge efforts, filter for the correct macro scopes, and rename
df_final <- df_filtered %>%
  left_join(effort_combined, by = c("Dataset", "Summary_Level", "Grouping")) %>%
  mutate(Effort_Minutes = replace_na(Effort_Minutes, 1)) %>%
  filter(
    Summary_Level %in% c("15_Second_Interval", "1_Minute_Interval", "15_Minute_Interval") |
    (Region == "STM" & Summary_Level == "Site") |
    (Region == "PER" & Summary_Level == "Site_Date")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Summary_Level = ifelse(Summary_Level %in% c("Site", "Site_Date"), "Macro (~1 Hour)", Summary_Level)
  )

# ==========================================
# 3. STATS FUNCTIONS (Effort-Weighted)
# ==========================================
get_r2 <- function(df_sub) {
  mod <- lm(SR ~ ER, data = df_sub, weights = Effort_Minutes)
  val <- summary(mod)$adj.r.squared
  return(sprintf("%.3f", val))
}

get_rho <- function(df_sub) {
  val <- cor(df_sub$ER, df_sub$SR, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
  return(sprintf("%.3f", val))
}

get_rmse <- function(df_sub) {
  mod <- lm(SR ~ ER, data = df_sub, weights = Effort_Minutes)
  weighted_rmse <- sqrt(sum(df_sub$Effort_Minutes * residuals(mod)^2) / sum(df_sub$Effort_Minutes))
  return(sprintf("%.3f", weighted_rmse))
}

get_mae <- function(df_sub) {
  mod <- lm(SR ~ ER, data = df_sub, weights = Effort_Minutes)
  weighted_mae <- sum(df_sub$Effort_Minutes * abs(residuals(mod))) / sum(df_sub$Effort_Minutes)
  return(sprintf("%.3f", weighted_mae))
}

# ==========================================
# 4. DYNAMIC PLOTTING FUNCTION
# ==========================================
create_model_comparison_plot <- function(scale_name, data, er_col_perch, perch_label, show_y_label = TRUE, show_x_label = TRUE) {
  
  # Create a named vector dynamically to properly map the selected variables in dplyr::select
  select_map <- c("SR", "Effort_Minutes", "Unsupervised Hierarchical Clusters" = er_col_cluster)
  select_map[perch_label] <- er_col_perch

  sub_df <- data %>% 
    filter(Summary_Level == scale_name) %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(select_map)) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(`Unsupervised Hierarchical Clusters`, all_of(perch_label)), 
                 names_to = "Model", values_to = "ER") %>%
    filter(!is.na(SR) & !is.na(ER)) %>%
    mutate(
      # Cap visual size at 60 mins to prevent anything artificially ballooning
      Plot_Effort = ifelse(Effort_Minutes > 60, 60, Effort_Minutes)
    )
  
  if(nrow(sub_df) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  stats_df <- sub_df %>%
    group_by(Model) %>%
    group_modify(~ {
      df_sub <- .x
      if (nrow(df_sub) < 3) return(data.frame(ideal_slope = NA, r2 = NA, rho = NA, rmse = NA, mae = NA))
      
      max_x <- max(df_sub$ER, na.rm = TRUE)
      max_y <- max(df_sub$SR, na.rm = TRUE)
      
      data.frame(
        r2 = get_r2(df_sub),
        rho = get_rho(df_sub),
        rmse = get_rmse(df_sub),
        mae = get_mae(df_sub),
        ideal_slope = max_y / max_x
      )
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(!is.na(r2)) %>%
    mutate(label = paste0("R\u00b2 = ", r2, "\n\u03c1 = ", rho, "\nRMSE = ", rmse, "\nMAE = ", mae))
  
  is_dense <- scale_name %in% c("15_Second_Interval", "1_Minute_Interval")
  is_macro <- scale_name == "Macro (~1 Hour)"
  pt_alpha <- ifelse(is_dense, 0.05, 0.6) 
  
  p <- ggplot(sub_df, aes(x = ER, y = SR, color = Model))
  
  # Using a standard linear model across all scales
  if (is_macro) {
    p <- p + geom_point(aes(size = Plot_Effort), alpha = pt_alpha) +
             scale_size_continuous(name = "Effort (Minutes)", 
                                   range = c(2, 6), 
                                   breaks = c(15, 30, 45, 60),
                                   guide = "none") 
    smooth_layer <- geom_smooth(aes(weight = Effort_Minutes), method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = TRUE, alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 1, show.legend = FALSE)
  } else {
    pt_size <- ifelse(is_dense, 1, 2.5)
    p <- p + geom_point(alpha = pt_alpha, size = pt_size)
    smooth_layer <- geom_smooth(aes(weight = Effort_Minutes), method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = TRUE, alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 1, show.legend = FALSE)
  }
  
  plot_title <- gsub("_", " ", scale_name)
  y_axis_lab <- if(show_y_label) "Observed Richness (SR)" else NULL
  x_axis_lab <- if(show_x_label) "Estimated Richness (ER)" else NULL
  
  p <- p + 
    geom_abline(data = stats_df, aes(intercept = 0, slope = ideal_slope), 
                linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.8, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    smooth_layer +
    geom_label(data = stats_df, 
               aes(x = Inf, y = -Inf, label = label, color = Model), 
               hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.1, 
               fill = "white", label.size = 0.5, label.padding = unit(0.3, "lines"),
               size = 3.5, fontface = "bold", lineheight = 0.9, show.legend = FALSE) +
    facet_wrap(~ Model, ncol = 2, scales = "free_x") + 
    scale_color_manual(
      values = setNames(c("#3C5488", "#E64B35"), c("Unsupervised Hierarchical Clusters", perch_label)),
      labels = setNames(c("Clusters", "Perch"), c("Unsupervised Hierarchical Clusters", perch_label))
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05))) + 
    labs(
      title = plot_title,
      x = x_axis_lab,
      y = y_axis_lab
    ) +
    theme_mee() +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 6, shape = 16, fill = NA)))
  
  return(p)
}

# ==========================================
# 5. BATCH GENERATE AND EXPORT
# ==========================================
cat("Starting batch plot generation...\n")

# Define the variable parameters
list_types <- c("region", "all")
thresholds <- c("0.1", "0.3", "0.5", "0.7", "0.9")

for (lt in list_types) {
  for (th in thresholds) {
    
    # Strip the leading 0 for file naming/column selection (e.g., "0.1" -> ".1")
    th_col_str <- sub("^0", "", th)
    
    # Dynamically build variables specific to this combination
    er_col_perch <- paste0("perchV2>", th_col_str, "_", lt)
    
    list_label <- ifelse(lt == "region", "region list", "all species")
    perch_label <- paste0("Perch conf >", th, " (", list_label, ")")
    
    cat(sprintf("\n--- Processing Threshold: %s | List: %s ---\n", th, lt))
    
    all_plots_model_split <- list()
    # Iterate using plot_scales so it loops over the 4 panels
    for (i in seq_along(plot_scales)) {
      scale <- plot_scales[i]
      is_last_row <- (i == length(plot_scales))
      cat("  > Generating:", scale, "\n")
      
      all_plots_model_split[[scale]] <- create_model_comparison_plot(
                                            scale_name = scale,
                                            data = df_final,
                                            er_col_perch = er_col_perch,
                                            perch_label = perch_label,
                                            show_y_label = TRUE, 
                                            show_x_label = is_last_row)
    }
    
    valid_model_plots <- all_plots_model_split[!sapply(all_plots_model_split, is.null)]
    
    if (length(valid_model_plots) > 0) {
      cat("  > Assembling layout...\n")
      # Adjusted height down from 18 to 15 since we removed a row
      p_model_grid <- wrap_plots(valid_model_plots, ncol = 1, nrow = length(plot_scales)) +
        plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
        theme(legend.position = "bottom")
      
      output_path <- paste0(output_dir, "SR_vs_ER_Combined_Only_Model_Split_", lt, "_", th_col_str, ".png")
      ggsave(output_path, p_model_grid, width = 10, height = 15, dpi = 300)
      cat("  > Done! Saved to:", output_path, "\n")
    }
  }
}

cat("\nAll 10 combinations generated successfully!\n")
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
input_file <- "/Users/Archibald/Documents/PhD/Chapter_1/Clusters/Master_Summary_SR_Cluster_Perch_and_Indices_Macro2.csv"
output_dir <- "/Users/Archibald/Documents/PhD/Chapter_1/plots/"

er_col_cluster <- "hier_euc_t0.7_br_noise_removed"

      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5)
    )
}

# ==========================================
# 2. DATA PREP & EFFORT CALCULATION
# ==========================================
cat("Loading data...\n")
df <- read.csv(input_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

df_filtered <- df %>%
  filter(Dataset %in% base_datasets,
         Summary_Level %in% initial_scales) %>%
  mutate(Region = ifelse(grepl("PER", Dataset), "PER", "STM"))

base_effort <- df %>%
  filter(
    (Dataset %in% c("PER", "STM_h", "STM_s_HTR") & Summary_Level == "15_Second_Interval") |
    (Dataset == "STM_s_LTR" & Summary_Level == "15_Minute_Interval")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Minute_Value = ifelse(Summary_Level == "15_Second_Interval", 0.25, 15),
    Target_Site_Date = sub("_[^_]+$", "", Grouping),
    Target_Site = sub("_[^_]+_[^_]+$", "", Grouping)
  )

effort_site_date <- base_effort %>%
  group_by(Dataset, Grouping = Target_Site_Date) %>%
  summarize(Effort_Minutes = sum(Minute_Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Summary_Level = "Site_Date")

effort_site <- base_effort %>%
  group_by(Dataset, Grouping = Target_Site) %>%
  summarize(Effort_Minutes = sum(Minute_Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Summary_Level = "Site")

effort_combined <- bind_rows(effort_site_date, effort_site)

# Merge efforts, filter for the correct scopes, and re-combine into Macro
df_final <- df_filtered %>%
  left_join(effort_combined, by = c("Dataset", "Summary_Level", "Grouping")) %>%
  mutate(Effort_Minutes = replace_na(Effort_Minutes, 1)) %>%
  filter(
    Summary_Level %in% c("15_Second_Interval", "1_Minute_Interval", "15_Minute_Interval") |
    (Region == "STM" & Summary_Level == "Site") |
    (Region == "PER" & Summary_Level == "Site_Date")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Summary_Level = ifelse(Summary_Level %in% c("Site", "Site_Date"), "Macro (~1 Hour)", Summary_Level)
  )

# ==========================================
# 3. STATS FUNCTIONS (Effort-Weighted)
# ==========================================
get_r2 <- function(df_sub) {
  mod <- lm(SR ~ ER, data = df_sub, weights = Effort_Minutes)
  val <- summary(mod)$adj.r.squared
  return(sprintf("%.3f", val))
}

get_rho <- function(df_sub) {
  val <- cor(df_sub$ER, df_sub$SR, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
  return(sprintf("%.3f", val))
}

get_rmse <- function(df_sub) {
  mod <- lm(SR ~ ER, data = df_sub, weights = Effort_Minutes)
  weighted_rmse <- sqrt(sum(df_sub$Effort_Minutes * residuals(mod)^2) / sum(df_sub$Effort_Minutes))
  return(sprintf("%.3f", weighted_rmse))
}

get_mae <- function(df_sub) {
  mod <- lm(SR ~ ER, data = df_sub, weights = Effort_Minutes)
  weighted_mae <- sum(df_sub$Effort_Minutes * abs(residuals(mod))) / sum(df_sub$Effort_Minutes)
  return(sprintf("%.3f", weighted_mae))
}

# ==========================================
# 4. DYNAMIC PLOTTING FUNCTION
# ==========================================
create_model_comparison_plot <- function(scale_name, data, er_col_perchV1, er_col_perchV2, perchV1_label, perchV2_label, show_y_label = TRUE, show_x_label = TRUE) {
  
  # Create a named vector dynamically to properly map the selected variables in dplyr::select
  select_map <- c("SR", "Effort_Minutes", "Unsupervised Hierarchical Clusters" = er_col_cluster)
  select_map[perchV1_label] <- er_col_perchV1
  select_map[perchV2_label] <- er_col_perchV2

  sub_df <- data %>% 
    filter(Summary_Level == scale_name) %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(select_map)) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(`Unsupervised Hierarchical Clusters`, all_of(perchV1_label), all_of(perchV2_label)), 
                 names_to = "Model", values_to = "ER") %>%
    filter(!is.na(SR) & !is.na(ER)) %>%
    mutate(
      # Factor the model column so it always plots as Clusters -> V1 -> V2
      Model = factor(Model, levels = c("Unsupervised Hierarchical Clusters", perchV1_label, perchV2_label))
    )
  
  if(nrow(sub_df) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  stats_df <- sub_df %>%
    group_by(Model) %>%
    group_modify(~ {
      df_sub <- .x
      if (nrow(df_sub) < 3) return(data.frame(ideal_slope = NA, r2 = NA, rho = NA, rmse = NA, mae = NA))
      
      max_x <- max(df_sub$ER, na.rm = TRUE)
      max_y <- max(df_sub$SR, na.rm = TRUE)
      
      data.frame(
        r2 = get_r2(df_sub),
        rho = get_rho(df_sub),
        rmse = get_rmse(df_sub),
        mae = get_mae(df_sub),
        ideal_slope = max_y / max_x
      )
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(!is.na(r2)) %>%
    mutate(label = paste0("R\u00b2 = ", r2, "\n\u03c1 = ", rho, "\nRMSE = ", rmse, "\nMAE = ", mae))
  
  is_dense <- scale_name %in% c("15_Second_Interval", "1_Minute_Interval")
  is_macro <- scale_name == "Macro (~1 Hour)"
  
  pt_alpha <- ifelse(is_dense, 0.05, 0.6) 
  pt_size <- ifelse(is_macro, 6, ifelse(is_dense, 1, 2.5))
  
  plot_title <- gsub("_", " ", scale_name)
  y_axis_lab <- if(show_y_label) "Observed Richness (SR)" else NULL
  x_axis_lab <- if(show_x_label) "Estimated Richness (ER)" else NULL
  
  p <- ggplot(sub_df, aes(x = ER, y = SR, color = Model)) +
    geom_point(alpha = pt_alpha, size = pt_size) +
    geom_abline(data = stats_df, aes(intercept = 0, slope = ideal_slope), 
                linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.8, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_smooth(aes(weight = Effort_Minutes), method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = TRUE, alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 1, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_label(data = stats_df, 
               aes(x = Inf, y = -Inf, label = label, color = Model), 
               hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.1, 
               fill = "white", label.size = 0.5, label.padding = unit(0.3, "lines"),
               size = 3.5, fontface = "bold", lineheight = 0.9, show.legend = FALSE) +
    # Switch to ncol = 3 to fit all three models
    facet_wrap(~ Model, ncol = 3, scales = "free_x") + 
    scale_color_manual(
      values = setNames(c("#3C5488", "#00A087", "#E64B35"), 
                        c("Unsupervised Hierarchical Clusters", perchV1_label, perchV2_label)),
      labels = setNames(c("Clusters", "Perch v1.0", "Perch v2.0"), 
                        c("Unsupervised Hierarchical Clusters", perchV1_label, perchV2_label))
    ) +
    
    # Force axes to start at exactly 0 and use integer-only breaks
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, NA), 
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)),
      breaks = function(x) { b <- pretty(x); b[b %% 1 == 0] }
    ) + 
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, NA), 
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15)),
      breaks = function(x) { b <- pretty(x); b[b %% 1 == 0] }
    ) +
    
    labs(
      title = plot_title,
      x = x_axis_lab,
      y = y_axis_lab
    ) +
    theme_mee() +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 9, shape = 16, fill = NA)))
  
  return(p)
}

# ==========================================
# 5. BATCH GENERATE AND EXPORT
# ==========================================
cat("Starting batch plot generation...\n")

# Define the variable parameters
list_types <- c("region", "all")
thresholds <- c("0.1", "0.3", "0.5", "0.7", "0.9")

for (lt in list_types) {
  for (th in thresholds) {
    
    # Strip the leading 0 for file naming/column selection (e.g., "0.1" -> ".1")
    th_col_str <- sub("^0", "", th)
    
    # Dynamically build variables specific to this combination for BOTH versions
    er_col_perchV1 <- paste0("perchV1>", th_col_str, "_", lt)
    er_col_perchV2 <- paste0("perchV2>", th_col_str, "_", lt)
    
    list_label <- ifelse(lt == "region", "region list", "all species")
    perchV1_label <- paste0("Perch v1.0 conf >", th, " (", list_label, ")")
    perchV2_label <- paste0("Perch v2.0 conf >", th, " (", list_label, ")")
    
    cat(sprintf("\n--- Processing Threshold: %s | List: %s ---\n", th, lt))
    
    all_plots_model_split <- list()
    # Iterate using plot_scales so it loops over the 4 panels
    for (i in seq_along(plot_scales)) {
      scale <- plot_scales[i]
      is_last_row <- (i == length(plot_scales))
      cat("  > Generating:", scale, "\n")
      
      all_plots_model_split[[scale]] <- create_model_comparison_plot(
                                                  scale_name = scale,
                                                  data = df_final,
                                                  er_col_perchV1 = er_col_perchV1,
                                                  er_col_perchV2 = er_col_perchV2,
                                                  perchV1_label = perchV1_label,
                                                  perchV2_label = perchV2_label,
                                                  show_y_label = TRUE, 
                                                  show_x_label = is_last_row)
    }
    
    valid_model_plots <- all_plots_model_split[!sapply(all_plots_model_split, is.null)]
    
    if (length(valid_model_plots) > 0) {
      cat("  > Assembling layout...\n")
      
      p_model_grid <- wrap_plots(valid_model_plots, ncol = 1, nrow = length(plot_scales)) +
        plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
        theme(legend.position = "bottom")
      
      output_path <- paste0(output_dir, "SR_vs_ER_Combined_Only_Model_Split_", lt, "_", th_col_str, "_v1_v2_2.png")
      
      # Height is set to 15 to fit the 4 rows
      ggsave(output_path, p_model_grid, width = 14, height = 15, dpi = 300)
      cat("  > Done! Saved to:", output_path, "\n")
    }
  }
}

cat("\nAll 10 combinations generated successfully!\n")
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# ==========================================
# 1. CONFIGURATION
# ==========================================
#input_file <- "/Users/Archibald/Documents/PhD/Chapter_1/Clusters/Master_Summary_SR_Cluster_Perch_br_3.csv"
input_file <- "/Users/Archibald/Documents/PhD/Chapter_1/Clusters/Master_Summary_SR_Cluster_Perch_and_Indices_Macro2.csv"

if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)

)

# ==========================================
# 2. DATA PREP & EFFORT CALCULATION
# ==========================================
cat("Loading data...\n")
df <- read.csv(input_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

# --- ADD THIS LINE ---
# This forces all your model columns to be numeric, turning text NAs into real NAs
df <- df %>%
  mutate(across(any_of(names(model_mapping)), ~as.numeric(na_if(as.character(.), ""))))

df_filtered <- df %>%
  filter(Dataset %in% base_datasets,
         Summary_Level %in% initial_scales) %>%

base_effort <- df %>%
  filter(

  )

effort_site_date <- base_effort %>%
  group_by(Dataset, Grouping = Target_Site_Date) %>%

effort_site <- base_effort %>%

  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Summary_Level = ifelse(Summary_Level %in% c("Site", "Site_Date"), "Macro", Summary_Level)
  )

# ==========================================
# 3. STATS FUNCTIONS (Returning Numerics)
# ==========================================
get_r2 <- function(df_sub) {
  mod <- lm(SR ~ ER, data = df_sub, weights = Effort_Minutes)
  return(summary(mod)$adj.r.squared)
}

get_rho <- function(df_sub) {

}

get_rmse <- function(df_sub) {

  return(sqrt(sum(df_sub$Effort_Minutes * residuals(mod)^2) / sum(df_sub$Effort_Minutes)))
}

get_mae <- function(df_sub) {
  mod <- lm(SR ~ ER, data = df_sub, weights = Effort_Minutes)
  return(sum(df_sub$Effort_Minutes * abs(residuals(mod))) / sum(df_sub$Effort_Minutes))
}

# ==========================================
# 4. CALCULATE METRICS & RESHAPE DATA
# ==========================================
cat("Calculating metrics...\n")

stats_df <- df_final %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = any_of(names(model_mapping)), 
               names_to = "Raw_Model", 
               values_to = "ER") %>%
  filter(!is.na(SR) & !is.na(ER)) %>%
  mutate(
    Model_Label = model_mapping[Raw_Model],
    Summary_Level = factor(Summary_Level, levels = ordered_scales)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Model_Label, Summary_Level) %>%
  summarize(
    R2 = get_r2(cur_data()),
   #Rho = get_rho(cur_data()),
    RMSE = get_rmse(cur_data()),
    MAE = get_mae(cur_data()),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Summary_Level,
    values_from = c(R2, 
                    #Rho, 
                    RMSE, MAE),
    names_glue = "{Summary_Level}_{.value}"
  ) %>%
  relocate(
    Model_Label,
    starts_with("15_Second_Interval"),
    starts_with("1_Minute_Interval"),
    starts_with("15_Minute_Interval"),
    starts_with("Macro")
  ) %>%
  arrange(factor(Model_Label, levels = unname(model_mapping)))

# ==========================================
# 5. GENERATE NESTED JOURNAL TABLE
# ==========================================
cat("Generating journal-ready table...\n")

pub_table <- stats_df %>%
  gt() %>%
  # --- SPANNERS ---
  tab_spanner(label = md("**15-Second Interval**"), columns = starts_with("15_Second_Interval_")) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = md("**1-Minute Interval**"), columns = starts_with("1_Minute_Interval_")) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = md("**15-Minute Interval**"), columns = starts_with("15_Minute_Interval_")) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = md("**Macro (~1 Hour)**"), columns = starts_with("Macro_")) %>%
  
  # --- LABELS & FORMATTING ---
  cols_label(
    Model_Label = "Model Configuration",
    ends_with("_R2") ~ md("*R*<sup>2</sup>"),
    #ends_with("_Rho") ~ md("&rho;"),
    ends_with("_RMSE") ~ "RMSE",
    ends_with("_MAE") ~ "MAE"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = -Model_Label, decimals = 3) %>%
  
  # --- STYLING ---
  tab_options(
    table.border.top.color = "black", table.border.top.width = px(2),
    table.border.bottom.color = "black", table.border.bottom.width = px(2),
    heading.border.bottom.color = "black", heading.border.bottom.width = px(1),
    column_labels.border.top.color = "black", column_labels.border.top.width = px(1),
    column_labels.border.bottom.color = "black", column_labels.border.bottom.width = px(1),
    table_body.border.bottom.color = "black", table_body.hlines.style = "none"
  ) %>%
  cols_align(align = "left", columns = Model_Label) %>%
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = -Model_Label) %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_fill(color = "#F5F5F5"), locations = cells_body(rows = Model_Label == "Unsupervised Clustering")) %>%
  tab_style(style = list(cell_text(align = "center")), locations = cells_column_spanners()) %>%
  
  # --- DASHED VERTICAL SEPARATORS ---
  tab_style(
    style = cell_borders(
      sides = "left", 
      color = "gray70", 
      style = "dashed", 
      weight = px(1)
    ),
    locations = list(
      cells_body(columns = c(`1_Minute_Interval_R2`, `15_Minute_Interval_R2`, Macro_R2)),
      cells_column_labels(columns = c(`1_Minute_Interval_R2`, `15_Minute_Interval_R2`, Macro_R2))
    )
  ) %>%

  # --- FOOTNOTE ---
  tab_source_note(
    source_note = md("Note: The top-performing models in each column are indicated by **bold** (1st), <u>underline</u> (2nd), and *italic* (3rd).")
  )

# --- DYNAMIC TYPOGRAPHY FOR TOP 3 RANKS ---
apply_top_3_styling <- function(table_obj, col_name, ranks) {
  table_obj %>%
    tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"), locations = cells_body(columns = all_of(col_name), rows = ranks == 1)) %>%
    tab_style(style = cell_text(style = "italic"), locations = cells_body(columns = all_of(col_name), rows = ranks == 3)) %>%
    tab_style(style = cell_text(decorate = "underline"), locations = cells_body(columns = all_of(col_name), rows = ranks == 2))
}

max_cols <- grep("_R2$|_Rho$", names(stats_df), value = TRUE)
for (col in max_cols) {
  col_ranks <- rank(-stats_df[[col]], na.last = "keep", ties.method = "min")
  pub_table <- apply_top_3_styling(pub_table, col, col_ranks)
}

min_cols <- grep("_RMSE$|_MAE$", names(stats_df), value = TRUE)
for (col in min_cols) {
  col_ranks <- rank(stats_df[[col]], na.last = "keep", ties.method = "min")
  pub_table <- apply_top_3_styling(pub_table, col, col_ranks)
}

# ==========================================
# 6. EXPORT
# ==========================================
gtsave(pub_table, paste0(output_dir, "Model_Performance_Summary_Table2_norho.html"))
gtsave(pub_table, paste0(output_dir, "Model_Performance_Summary_Table2_norho.docx"))

cat("Done! Table saved to:", output_dir, "as HTML and Word document (.docx)\n")
```

```{r}
  mutate(Region = ifelse(grepl("PER", Dataset), "PER", "STM"))

base_effort <- df %>%
  filter(
    (Dataset %in% c("PER", "STM_h", "STM_s_HTR") & Summary_Level == "15_Second_Interval") |
    (Dataset == "STM_s_LTR" & Summary_Level == "15_Minute_Interval")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Minute_Value = ifelse(Summary_Level == "15_Second_Interval", 0.25, 15),
    Target_Site_Date = sub("_[^_]+$", "", Grouping),
    Target_Site = sub("_[^_]+_[^_]+$", "", Grouping)
  )

effort_site_date <- base_effort %>%
  group_by(Dataset, Grouping = Target_Site_Date) %>%
  summarize(Effort_Minutes = sum(Minute_Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Summary_Level = "Site_Date")

effort_site <- base_effort %>%
  group_by(Dataset, Grouping = Target_Site) %>%
  summarize(Effort_Minutes = sum(Minute_Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Summary_Level = "Site")

effort_combined <- bind_rows(effort_site_date, effort_site)

# Merge efforts, filter for the correct macro scopes, and rename to "Macro"
df_final <- df_filtered %>%
  left_join(effort_combined, by = c("Dataset", "Summary_Level", "Grouping")) %>%
  mutate(Effort_Minutes = replace_na(Effort_Minutes, 1)) %>%
  filter(
    Summary_Level %in% c("15_Second_Interval", "1_Minute_Interval", "15_Minute_Interval") |
    (Region == "STM" & Summary_Level == "Site") |
    (Region == "PER" & Summary_Level == "Site_Date")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Summary_Level = ifelse(Summary_Level %in% c("Site", "Site_Date"), "Macro", Summary_Level)
  )

# ==========================================
# 3. STATS FUNCTIONS (Returning Numerics)
# ==========================================
get_r2 <- function(df_sub) {
  mod <- lm(SR ~ ER, data = df_sub, weights = Effort_Minutes)
  return(summary(mod)$adj.r.squared)
}

get_rho <- function(df_sub) {
  return(cor(df_sub$ER, df_sub$SR, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"))
}

get_rmse <- function(df_sub) {
  mod <- lm(SR ~ ER, data = df_sub, weights = Effort_Minutes)
  return(sqrt(sum(df_sub$Effort_Minutes * residuals(mod)^2) / sum(df_sub$Effort_Minutes)))
}

get_mae <- function(df_sub) {
  mod <- lm(SR ~ ER, data = df_sub, weights = Effort_Minutes)
  return(sum(df_sub$Effort_Minutes * abs(residuals(mod))) / sum(df_sub$Effort_Minutes))
}

# ==========================================
# 4. CALCULATE METRICS & RESHAPE DATA
# ==========================================
cat("Calculating metrics...\n")

stats_df <- df_final %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = any_of(names(model_mapping)), 
               names_to = "Raw_Model", 
               values_to = "ER") %>%
  filter(!is.na(SR) & !is.na(ER)) %>%
  mutate(
    Model_Label = model_mapping[Raw_Model],
    Summary_Level = factor(Summary_Level, levels = ordered_scales)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Model_Label, Summary_Level) %>%
  summarize(
    R2 = get_r2(cur_data()),
    Rho = get_rho(cur_data()),
    RMSE = get_rmse(cur_data()),
    MAE = get_mae(cur_data()),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Summary_Level,
    values_from = c(R2, Rho, RMSE, MAE),
    names_glue = "{Summary_Level}_{.value}"
  ) %>%
  relocate(
    Model_Label,
    starts_with("15_Second_Interval"),
    starts_with("1_Minute_Interval"),
    starts_with("15_Minute_Interval"),
    starts_with("Macro")
  ) %>%
  arrange(factor(Model_Label, levels = unname(model_mapping)))

# ==========================================
# 5. GENERATE NESTED JOURNAL TABLE
# ==========================================
cat("Generating journal-ready table...\n")

pub_table <- stats_df %>%
  gt() %>%
  # --- SPANNERS ---
  tab_spanner(label = md("**15-Second Interval**"), columns = starts_with("15_Second_Interval_")) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = md("**1-Minute Interval**"), columns = starts_with("1_Minute_Interval_")) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = md("**15-Minute Interval**"), columns = starts_with("15_Minute_Interval_")) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = md("**Macro (~1 Hour)**"), columns = starts_with("Macro_")) %>%
  
  # --- LABELS & FORMATTING ---
  cols_label(
    Model_Label = "Model Configuration",
    ends_with("_R2") ~ md("*R*<sup>2</sup>"),
    ends_with("_Rho") ~ md("&rho;"),
    ends_with("_RMSE") ~ "RMSE",
    ends_with("_MAE") ~ "MAE"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = -Model_Label, decimals = 3) %>%
  
  # --- STYLING ---
  tab_options(
    table.border.top.color = "black", table.border.top.width = px(2),
    table.border.bottom.color = "black", table.border.bottom.width = px(2),
    heading.border.bottom.color = "black", heading.border.bottom.width = px(1),
    column_labels.border.top.color = "black", column_labels.border.top.width = px(1),
    column_labels.border.bottom.color = "black", column_labels.border.bottom.width = px(1),
    table_body.border.bottom.color = "black", table_body.hlines.style = "none"
  ) %>%
  cols_align(align = "left", columns = Model_Label) %>%
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = -Model_Label) %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_fill(color = "#F5F5F5"), locations = cells_body(rows = Model_Label == "Unsupervised Clustering")) %>%
  tab_style(style = list(cell_text(align = "center")), locations = cells_column_spanners()) %>%
  
  # --- DASHED VERTICAL SEPARATORS ---
  tab_style(
    style = cell_borders(
      sides = "left", 
      color = "gray70", 
      style = "dashed", 
      weight = px(1)
    ),
    locations = list(
      cells_body(columns = c(`1_Minute_Interval_R2`, `15_Minute_Interval_R2`, Macro_R2)),
      cells_column_labels(columns = c(`1_Minute_Interval_R2`, `15_Minute_Interval_R2`, Macro_R2))
    )
  ) %>%

  # --- FOOTNOTE ---
  tab_source_note(
    source_note = md("Note: The top-performing models in each column are indicated by **bold** (1st), <u>underline</u> (2nd), and *italic* (3rd).")
  )

# --- DYNAMIC TYPOGRAPHY FOR TOP 3 RANKS ---
apply_top_3_styling <- function(table_obj, col_name, ranks) {
  table_obj %>%
    tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"), locations = cells_body(columns = all_of(col_name), rows = ranks == 1)) %>%
    tab_style(style = cell_text(style = "italic"), locations = cells_body(columns = all_of(col_name), rows = ranks == 3)) %>%
    tab_style(style = cell_text(decorate = "underline"), locations = cells_body(columns = all_of(col_name), rows = ranks == 2))
}

max_cols <- grep("_R2$|_Rho$", names(stats_df), value = TRUE)
for (col in max_cols) {
  col_ranks <- rank(-stats_df[[col]], na.last = "keep", ties.method = "min")
  pub_table <- apply_top_3_styling(pub_table, col, col_ranks)
}

min_cols <- grep("_RMSE$|_MAE$", names(stats_df), value = TRUE)
for (col in min_cols) {
  col_ranks <- rank(stats_df[[col]], na.last = "keep", ties.method = "min")
  pub_table <- apply_top_3_styling(pub_table, col, col_ranks)
}

# ==========================================
# 6. EXPORT
# ==========================================
gtsave(pub_table, paste0(output_dir, "Model_Performance_Summary_Table_v1_v2_2.html"))
gtsave(pub_table, paste0(output_dir, "Model_Performance_Summary_Table_v1_v2_2.docx"))

cat("Done! Table saved to:", output_dir, "as HTML and Word document (.docx)\n")
```

```{r}
target_scales <- c(

)

# Using EXACTLY the metrics requested
metrics_list <- c(

  "br_ACI", "br_BI", "br_surface_roughness", "br_spectral_snr",

  "fr_ACI", "fr_BI", "fr_surface_roughness", "fr_spectral_snr", 
  "fr_ACTspfract_avg", "fr_EVNspCount_sum", "fr_EVNspFract_avg", "fr_ROIcover"

theme_mee_bar <- function() {
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
      axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = 11),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "gray30"),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "gray90", linetype = "solid"), 
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
    )
}

clean_metric_name <- function(raw_name) {
  # Handle Macro Suffixes
  suffix <- ""
  if (grepl("_15s_avg$", raw_name)) suffix <- " (15sec avgs)"
  if (grepl("_1m_avg$", raw_name)) suffix <- " (1min avgs)"
  if (grepl("_15m_avg$", raw_name)) suffix <- " (15min avgs)"
  
  core_name <- str_remove(raw_name, "_15s_avg$|_1m_avg$|_15m_avg$")
  
  if (core_name == "hier_euc_t0.7_br_noise_removed") return(paste0("[BR, noise removed] Hierarchical Clustering", suffix))
  if (core_name == "hier_euc_t0.7_fr_noise_removed") return(paste0("[FR, noise removed] Hierarchical Clustering", suffix))
  if (core_name == "hier_euc_t0.7_br_all_channels") return(paste0("[BR, all channels] Hierarchical Clustering", suffix))
  if (core_name == "hier_euc_t0.7_fr_all_channels") return(paste0("[FR, all channels] Hierarchical Clustering", suffix))
  if (core_name == "br_3") return(paste0("[BR] Active Channels", suffix))
  if (core_name == "fr_3") return(paste0("[FR] Active Channels", suffix))
  
  if (grepl("perch", core_name)) {
    clean <- gsub("perchV[12]>", "Perch (Conf > ", core_name)
    clean <- gsub("_all", " All)", clean)
    clean <- gsub("_region", " Region)", clean)
    return(paste0(clean, suffix))
  }
  
  if (grepl("^br_", core_name) || grepl("^fr_", core_name)) {
    prefix <- ifelse(grepl("^br_", core_name), "[BR] ", "[FR] ")
    core <- gsub("^[bf]r_", "", core_name)
    core <- gsub("_avg", " (Avg)", core)
    core <- gsub("_sum", " (Sum)", core)
    core <- gsub("surface_roughness", "Surface Roughness", core)
    core <- gsub("spectral_snr", "Spectral SNR", core)
    return(paste0(prefix, core, suffix))
  }
  return(paste0(raw_name, suffix))
}

# ==========================================
# 2. LOAD DATA
# ==========================================
cat("Loading master dataset...\n")
df <- read.csv(input_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

# Convert metric columns to numeric
df <- df %>% mutate(across(all_of(intersect(metrics_list, colnames(df))), ~as.numeric(na_if(as.character(.), ""))))

# ==========================================
# 3. BASE SCALES
# ==========================================
plots_list <- list()

for (scale in names(target_scales)) {
  scale_title <- target_scales[[scale]]
  cat(sprintf("\n=== Processing scale: %s ===\n", scale))
  
  # Removed Dataset filtering completely
  df_sub <- df %>% 
    filter(Summary_Level == scale) %>% 
    dplyr::select(SR, all_of(intersect(metrics_list, colnames(df))))
  
  if (nrow(df_sub) == 0) { cat("Warning: No rows found.\n"); next }

  # CRUCIAL STEP: Find metrics that actually exist at this scale (ignoring 100% NA columns like br_3 for 1-min)
  valid_metrics <- df_sub %>% 
    dplyr::select(-SR) %>% summarise(across(everything(), ~sum(!is.na(.)))) %>% 
    pivot_longer(everything()) %>% filter(value > 0) %>% pull(name)
  
  if (length(valid_metrics) == 0) { cat("Warning: No valid metric data.\n"); next }
  
  # ONLY run drop_na() on the valid metrics, preserving the data size
  df_complete <- df_sub %>% dplyr::select(SR, all_of(valid_metrics)) %>% drop_na()
  
  cat("Total Raw Rows:", nrow(df_sub), "\n")
  cat("Rows surviving drop_na() (N for models):", nrow(df_complete), "\n")
  
  if (nrow(df_complete) < 3) { cat("Warning: Not enough complete observations.\n"); next }

  results_list <- list()
  for (metric in valid_metrics) {
    mod <- lm(as.formula(paste0("SR ~ `", metric, "`")), data = df_complete)
    
    category <- "Traditional Acoustic Index"
    if (grepl("hier", metric)) category <- "Unsupervised Clustering"
    if (grepl("br_3|fr_3", metric)) category <- "Source Separation"
    if (grepl("perch", metric)) category <- "Perch Classifier"
    
    results_list[[metric]] <- data.frame(
      Raw_Name = metric, Clean_Name = clean_metric_name(metric),
      Category = category, R2 = max(0, summary(mod)$adj.r.squared), AIC = AIC(mod)
    )
  }
  
  results_df <- bind_rows(results_list) %>%
    mutate(
      Delta_AIC = AIC - min(AIC),
      Bar_Label = ifelse(Delta_AIC < 2, 
                         paste0(sprintf("%.3f", R2), " <b style='font-size: 22pt; color: black;'>*</b>"), 
                         sprintf("%.3f", R2))
    ) %>%
    arrange(R2) %>% mutate(Clean_Name = factor(Clean_Name, levels = Clean_Name))
  
  p_rank <- ggplot(results_df, aes(x = R2, y = Clean_Name, fill = Category)) +
    geom_col(color = "black", width = 0.8) +
    geom_richtext(aes(label = Bar_Label), hjust = -0.15, size = 3.5, fill = NA, label.color = NA, color = "black") +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.20))) + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Unsupervised Clustering" = "#009E73", "Source Separation" = "#0072B2", "Perch Classifier" = "#CC79A7", "Traditional Acoustic Index" = "#E69F00")) +
    labs(title = paste0("Predictive Power of Models (", scale_title, ")"), subtitle = "Ranked by Adjusted R² | * Indicates top-performing model(s) (\U0394 AIC < 2)", x = "Adjusted R²", y = NULL) +
    theme_mee_bar() + guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1), order = 1))
  
  plots_list[[scale]] <- p_rank
}

# ==========================================
# 4. MACRO (1-HOUR) SCALE
# ==========================================
cat("\n=== Processing scale: Macro (1-Hour) Resolution ===\n")

# Acoustic indices for averaging
acoustic_indices <- metrics_list[grepl("^br_|^fr_", metrics_list) & !grepl("3$", metrics_list)]

# Updated to avoid relying on Dataset flags
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Date_Extracted = str_extract(Grouping, "\\d{8}"),
    # Safely extract Site, or use entire Grouping if no date pattern exists
    Site_Extracted = ifelse(is.na(Date_Extracted), Grouping, str_extract(Grouping, "^.*?(?=_\\d{8})")),
    # Macro Group joins Site + Date if a date exists, otherwise just uses Site
    Macro_Group = ifelse(!is.na(Date_Extracted), paste(Site_Extracted, Date_Extracted, sep = "_"), Site_Extracted)
  )

# Group only by Macro_Group now
calc_macro_avg <- function(data, suffix) {
  data %>% group_by(Macro_Group) %>%
    summarise(across(all_of(acoustic_indices), \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") %>%
    rename_with(~paste0(., suffix), all_of(acoustic_indices))
}

# No longer filtering by Dataset to calculate macro groupings
df_15s_macro <- df %>% filter(Summary_Level == "15_Second_Interval") %>% calc_macro_avg("_15s_avg")
df_1m_macro <- df %>% filter(Summary_Level == "1_Minute_Interval") %>% calc_macro_avg("_1m_avg")
df_15m_macro <- df %>% filter(Summary_Level == "15_Minute_Interval") %>% calc_macro_avg("_15m_avg")

# Keep all true site/date summaries regardless of Dataset
macro_true_rows <- df %>%
  filter(Summary_Level %in% c("Site", "Site_Date")) %>%
  dplyr::select(Macro_Group, SR, all_of(intersect(metrics_list, colnames(df))))

# Join entirely on Macro_Group
macro_df_complete <- macro_true_rows %>%
  left_join(df_15s_macro, by = "Macro_Group") %>%
  left_join(df_1m_macro, by = "Macro_Group") %>%
  left_join(df_15m_macro, by = "Macro_Group")

macro_results <- list()

# Fit models pairwise for macro to prevent massive data loss across mismatched average types
for (metric in setdiff(colnames(macro_df_complete), c("Macro_Group", "SR"))) {
  df_mod <- macro_df_complete %>% dplyr::select(SR, all_of(metric)) %>% drop_na()
  
  if (nrow(df_mod) >= 3) {
    mod <- lm(as.formula(paste0("SR ~ `", metric, "`")), data = df_mod)
    
    category <- "Traditional Acoustic Index"
    if (grepl("hier", metric)) category <- "Unsupervised Clustering"
    if (grepl("br_3|fr_3", metric)) category <- "Source Separation"
    if (grepl("perch", metric)) category <- "Perch Classifier"
    
    macro_results[[metric]] <- data.frame(
      Raw_Name = metric, Clean_Name = clean_metric_name(metric),
      Category = category, R2 = max(0, summary(mod)$adj.r.squared)
    )
  }
}

macro_res_df <- bind_rows(macro_results) %>%
  arrange(R2) %>% mutate(Clean_Name = factor(Clean_Name, levels = Clean_Name), Bar_Label = sprintf("%.3f", R2))

p_macro <- ggplot(macro_res_df, aes(x = R2, y = Clean_Name, fill = Category)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", width = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Bar_Label), hjust = -0.15, size = 3.5, color = "black") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.20))) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Unsupervised Clustering" = "#009E73", "Source Separation" = "#0072B2", "Perch Classifier" = "#CC79A7", "Traditional Acoustic Index" = "#E69F00")) +
  labs(title = "Predictive Power of Models (Macro / 1-Hour Resolution)", subtitle = "Ranked by Adjusted R²", x = "Adjusted R²", y = NULL) +
  theme_mee_bar() + guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1), order = 1))

plots_list[["Macro"]] <- p_macro

# ==========================================
# 5. COMBINE & EXPORT
# ==========================================
cat("Combining plots using patchwork...\n")

combined_plot <- (
  (plots_list[["15_Second_Interval"]] / plots_list[["1_Minute_Interval"]] / plots_list[["15_Minute_Interval"]]) | 
  plots_list[["Macro"]]
) + plot_layout(guides = 'collect') & theme(legend.position = 'bottom')

output_path <- paste0(output_dir, "Figure3_Combined_Resolutions.png")
ggsave(output_path, combined_plot, width = 20, height = 14, dpi = 300)
cat("Saved Combined Plot PNG to", output_path, "\n")
```

```{r}
  if (core_name == "hier_euc_t0.7_br_all_channels") return(paste0("[BR, all channels] Hierarchical Clustering", suffix))
  if (core_name == "hier_euc_t0.7_fr_all_channels") return(paste0("[FR, all channels] Hierarchical Clustering", suffix))
  if (core_name == "br_3") return(paste0("[BR] Active Channels", suffix))
  if (core_name == "fr_3") return(paste0("[FR] Active Channels", suffix))
  
  if (grepl("perch", core_name)) {
    clean <- gsub("perchV[12]>", "Perch (Conf > ", core_name)
    clean <- gsub("_all", " All)", clean)
    clean <- gsub("_region", " Region)", clean)
    return(paste0(clean, suffix))
  }
  
  if (grepl("^br_", core_name) || grepl("^fr_", core_name)) {
    prefix <- ifelse(grepl("^br_", core_name), "[BR] ", "[FR] ")
    core <- gsub("^[bf]r_", "", core_name)
    core <- gsub("_avg", " (Avg)", core)
    core <- gsub("_sum", " (Sum)", core)
    core <- gsub("surface_roughness", "Surface Roughness", core)
    core <- gsub("spectral_snr", "Spectral SNR", core)
    return(paste0(prefix, core, suffix))
  }
  return(paste0(raw_name, suffix))
}

# ==========================================
# 2. LOAD DATA
# ==========================================
cat("Loading master dataset...\n")
df <- read.csv(input_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
df <- df %>% mutate(across(all_of(intersect(metrics_list, colnames(df))), ~as.numeric(na_if(as.character(.), ""))))

# ==========================================
# 3. BASE SCALES
# ==========================================
plots_list <- list()

for (scale in names(target_scales)) {
  scale_title <- target_scales[[scale]]
  cat(sprintf("\n=== Processing scale: %s ===\n", scale))
  
  df_sub <- df %>% 
    filter(Summary_Level == scale) %>% 
    dplyr::select(SR, all_of(intersect(metrics_list, colnames(df))))
  
  if (nrow(df_sub) == 0) { cat("Warning: No rows found.\n"); next }

  valid_metrics <- df_sub %>% 
    dplyr::select(-SR) %>% summarise(across(everything(), ~sum(!is.na(.)))) %>% 
    pivot_longer(everything()) %>% filter(value > 0) %>% pull(name)
  
  if (length(valid_metrics) == 0) { cat("Warning: No valid metric data.\n"); next }
  
  cat("Total Raw Rows:", nrow(df_sub), "\n")
  
  # --- DIAGNOSTIC: Print N for each valid metric before listwise deletion ---
  cat("\n--- DIAGNOSTIC: Non-NA counts per metric (Look for the lowest numbers here!) ---\n")
  missing_report <- df_sub %>% dplyr::select(all_of(valid_metrics)) %>% summarise(across(everything(), ~sum(!is.na(.))))
  print(t(as.matrix(missing_report)))
  cat("----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n")
  
  # LISTWISE DELETION
  df_complete <- df_sub %>% dplyr::select(SR, all_of(valid_metrics)) %>% drop_na()
  cat("Rows surviving listwise deletion (Consistent N):", nrow(df_complete), "\n")
  
  if (nrow(df_complete) < 3) { 
    cat("CRITICAL WARNING: Listwise deletion left fewer than 3 rows. Skipping this scale.\n")
    next 
  }

  results_list <- list()
  for (metric in valid_metrics) {
    rho_val <- suppressWarnings(cor(df_complete$SR, df_complete[[metric]], method = "spearman"))
    
    category <- "Traditional Acoustic Index"
    if (grepl("hier", metric)) category <- "Unsupervised Clustering"
    if (grepl("br_3|fr_3", metric)) category <- "Source Separation"
    if (grepl("perch", metric)) category <- "Perch Classifier"
    
    results_list[[metric]] <- data.frame(
      Raw_Name = metric, Clean_Name = clean_metric_name(metric),
      Category = category, Rho = rho_val, N_Obs = nrow(df_complete)
    )
  }
  
  if(length(results_list) > 0) {
    results_df <- bind_rows(results_list) %>%
      arrange(Rho) %>% 
      mutate(
        Clean_Name = factor(Clean_Name, levels = Clean_Name),
        Bar_Label = sprintf("%.3f (N=%d)", Rho, N_Obs) 
      )
    
    plots_list[[scale]] <- ggplot(results_df, aes(x = Rho, y = Clean_Name, fill = Category)) +
      geom_col(color = "black", width = 0.8) +
      geom_richtext(aes(label = Bar_Label, hjust = ifelse(Rho >= 0, -0.15, 1.15)), size = 5, fill = NA, label.color = NA, color = "black") +
      scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.15, 0.25))) + 
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("Unsupervised Clustering" = "#009E73", "Source Separation" = "#0072B2", "Perch Classifier" = "#CC79A7", "Traditional Acoustic Index" = "#E69F00")) +
      labs(
        title = paste0("Predictive Power of Metrics (", scale_title, ")"), 
        subtitle = paste0("Ranked by Spearman's \u03C1 | Listwise N = ", unique(results_df$N_Obs)), 
        x = "Spearman's Rho (\u03C1)", y = NULL
      ) +
      theme_mee_bar() + guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1), order = 1))
  }
}

# ==========================================
# 4. MACRO (1-HOUR) SCALE
# ==========================================
cat("\n=== Processing scale: Macro (1-Hour) Resolution ===\n")

acoustic_indices <- metrics_list[grepl("^br_|^fr_", metrics_list) & !grepl("3$", metrics_list)]

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Date_Extracted = str_extract(Grouping, "\\d{8}"),
    Site_Extracted = ifelse(is.na(Date_Extracted), Grouping, str_extract(Grouping, "^.*?(?=_\\d{8})")),
    Macro_Group = ifelse(!is.na(Date_Extracted), paste(Site_Extracted, Date_Extracted, sep = "_"), Site_Extracted)
  )

calc_macro_avg <- function(data, suffix) {
  data %>% group_by(Macro_Group) %>%
    summarise(across(all_of(acoustic_indices), \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") %>%
    rename_with(~paste0(., suffix), all_of(acoustic_indices))
}

df_15s_macro <- df %>% filter(Summary_Level == "15_Second_Interval") %>% calc_macro_avg("_15s_avg")
df_1m_macro <- df %>% filter(Summary_Level == "1_Minute_Interval") %>% calc_macro_avg("_1m_avg")
df_15m_macro <- df %>% filter(Summary_Level == "15_Minute_Interval") %>% calc_macro_avg("_15m_avg")

macro_true_rows <- df %>%
  filter(Summary_Level %in% c("Site", "Site_Date")) %>%
  dplyr::select(Macro_Group, SR, all_of(intersect(metrics_list, colnames(df))))

macro_df_complete <- macro_true_rows %>%
  left_join(df_15s_macro, by = "Macro_Group") %>%
  left_join(df_1m_macro, by = "Macro_Group") %>%
  left_join(df_15m_macro, by = "Macro_Group")

macro_metrics_all <- setdiff(colnames(macro_df_complete), c("Macro_Group", "SR"))
valid_macro_metrics <- macro_df_complete %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(macro_metrics_all)) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~sum(!is.na(.)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything()) %>% filter(value > 0) %>% pull(name)

cat("Macro Raw Groups:", nrow(macro_df_complete), "\n")

# --- DIAGNOSTIC: Print N for each macro metric before listwise deletion ---
cat("\n--- DIAGNOSTIC: Macro non-NA counts per metric ---\n")
missing_macro_report <- macro_df_complete %>% dplyr::select(all_of(valid_macro_metrics)) %>% summarise(across(everything(), ~sum(!is.na(.))))
print(t(as.matrix(missing_macro_report)))
cat("----------------------------------------------------\n")

# LISTWISE DELETION
macro_df_complete_clean <- macro_df_complete %>% 
  dplyr::select(Macro_Group, SR, all_of(valid_macro_metrics)) %>% 
  drop_na()

cat("Macro Groups surviving listwise deletion:", nrow(macro_df_complete_clean), "\n")

if (nrow(macro_df_complete_clean) < 3) {
  cat("CRITICAL WARNING: Macro scale dropped below 3 rows after listwise deletion. Skipping plot.\n")
} else {
  macro_results <- list()
  for (metric in valid_macro_metrics) {
    rho_val <- suppressWarnings(cor(macro_df_complete_clean$SR, macro_df_complete_clean[[metric]], method = "spearman"))
    
    category <- "Traditional Acoustic Index"
    if (grepl("hier", metric)) category <- "Unsupervised Clustering"
    if (grepl("br_3|fr_3", metric)) category <- "Source Separation"
    if (grepl("perch", metric)) category <- "Perch Classifier"
    
    macro_results[[metric]] <- data.frame(
      Raw_Name = metric, Clean_Name = clean_metric_name(metric),
      Category = category, Rho = rho_val, N_Obs = nrow(macro_df_complete_clean)
    )
  }

  if(length(macro_results) > 0) {
    macro_res_df <- bind_rows(macro_results) %>%
      arrange(Rho) %>% 
      mutate(
        Clean_Name = factor(Clean_Name, levels = Clean_Name), 
        Bar_Label = sprintf("%.3f (N=%d)", Rho, N_Obs)
      )

    plots_list[["Macro"]] <- ggplot(macro_res_df, aes(x = Rho, y = Clean_Name, fill = Category)) +
      geom_col(color = "black", width = 0.8) +
      geom_text(aes(label = Bar_Label, hjust = ifelse(Rho >= 0, -0.15, 1.15)), size = 3.5, color = "black") +
      scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.15, 0.25))) + 
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("Unsupervised Clustering" = "#009E73", "Source Separation" = "#0072B2", "Perch Classifier" = "#CC79A7", "Traditional Acoustic Index" = "#E69F00")) +
      labs(
        title = "Predictive Power of Metrics (Macro / 1-Hour Resolution)", 
        subtitle = paste0("Ranked by Spearman's \u03C1 | Listwise N = ", unique(macro_res_df$N_Obs)), 
        x = "Spearman's Rho (\u03C1)", y = NULL
      ) +
      theme_mee_bar() + guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1), order = 1))
  }
}

# ==========================================
# 5. COMBINE & EXPORT
# ==========================================
if(length(plots_list) > 0) {
  cat("Combining plots using patchwork...\n")
  # Filter out NULLs in case some scales failed
  plots_list <- Filter(Negate(is.null), plots_list)
  
  combined_plot <- wrap_plots(plots_list, ncol = 2) + 
    plot_layout(guides = 'collect') & theme(legend.position = 'bottom')

  output_path <- paste0(output_dir, "Figure4_Combined_Resolutions_spearmanrho.png")
  ggsave(output_path, combined_plot, width = 20, height = 14, dpi = 300)
  cat("Saved Combined Plot PNG to", output_path, "\n")
} else {
  cat("All plots failed due to missing data. No output generated.\n")
}
```

fig 4 adjusted R2

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggtext)
library(patchwork)

# ==========================================
# 1. CONFIGURATION
# ==========================================
input_file <- "/Users/Archibald/Documents/PhD/Chapter_1/Clusters/Master_Summary_SR_Cluster_Perch_and_Indices_Macro2.csv"
output_dir <- "/Users/Archibald/Documents/PhD/Chapter_1/plots/"

if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)

target_scales <- c(
  "15_Second_Interval" = "15-Second Resolution",
  "1_Minute_Interval"  = "1-Minute Resolution",
  "15_Minute_Interval" = "15-Minute Resolution",
  "Macro"              = "Macro (~1 Hour) Resolution"
)

base_datasets <- c("PER", "STM_h", "STM_s_HTR", "STM_s_LTR")

# Using EXACTLY the metrics requested
metrics_list <- c(
  "hier_euc_t0.7_br_noise_removed", "hier_euc_t0.7_fr_noise_removed", "hier_euc_t0.7_fr_all_channels",
  "hier_euc_t0.7_br_all_channels",
  "perchV2>.1_all", "perchV2>.1_region", "perchV2>.3_all", "perchV2>.3_region", 
  "perchV2>.5_all", "perchV2>.5_region", "perchV2>.7_all", "perchV2>.7_region", 
  "perchV2>.9_all", "perchV2>.9_region",
  "br_3", "fr_3",
  "br_ACI", "br_BI", "br_surface_roughness", "br_spectral_snr", 
  "br_ACTspfract_avg", "br_EVNspCount_sum", "br_EVNspFract_avg", "br_ROIcover",
  "fr_ACI", "fr_BI", "fr_surface_roughness", "fr_spectral_snr", 
  "fr_ACTspfract_avg", "fr_EVNspCount_sum", "fr_EVNspFract_avg", "fr_ROIcover"
)

theme_mee_bar <- function() {
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
      axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = 11),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, hjust = 0),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "gray30"),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),       
      legend.text = element_text(size = 16),                       
      legend.key.size = unit(1.2, "cm"),                           
      legend.spacing.x = unit(0.4, "cm"),                          
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "gray90", linetype = "solid"), 
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
    )
}

clean_metric_name <- function(raw_name) {
  if (raw_name == "hier_euc_t0.7_br_noise_removed") return("[BR, noise removed] Hierarchical Clustering")
  if (raw_name == "hier_euc_t0.7_fr_noise_removed") return("[FR, noise removed] Hierarchical Clustering")
  if (raw_name == "hier_euc_t0.7_br_all_channels") return("[BR, all channels] Hierarchical Clustering")
  if (raw_name == "hier_euc_t0.7_fr_all_channels") return("[FR, all channels] Hierarchical Clustering")
  if (raw_name == "br_3") return("[BR] Active Channels")
  if (raw_name == "fr_3") return("[FR] Active Channels")
  
  if (grepl("perch", raw_name)) {
    clean <- gsub("perchV[12]>", "Perch (Conf > ", raw_name)
    clean <- gsub("_all", " All)", clean)
    clean <- gsub("_region", " Region)", clean)
    return(clean)
  }
  
  if (grepl("^br_", raw_name) || grepl("^fr_", raw_name)) {
    prefix <- ifelse(grepl("^br_", raw_name), "[BR] ", "[FR] ")
    core <- gsub("^[bf]r_", "", raw_name)
    core <- gsub("_avg", " (Avg)", core)
    core <- gsub("_sum", " (Sum)", core)
    core <- gsub("surface_roughness", "Surface Roughness", core)
    core <- gsub("spectral_snr", "Spectral SNR", core)
    return(paste0(prefix, core))
  }
  return(raw_name)
}

# ==========================================
# 2. LOAD DATA & SYNC MACRO LOGIC WITH TABLE SCRIPT
# ==========================================
cat("Loading and processing master dataset...\n")
df <- read.csv(input_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
df <- df %>% mutate(across(all_of(intersect(metrics_list, colnames(df))), ~as.numeric(na_if(as.character(.), ""))))

# 1. Filter Datasets identically to Table Script
df_filtered <- df %>%
  filter(Dataset %in% base_datasets) %>%
  mutate(Region = ifelse(grepl("PER", Dataset), "PER", "STM"))

# 2. Calculate Effort Minutes identically to Table Script
base_effort <- df %>%
  filter(
    (Dataset %in% c("PER", "STM_h", "STM_s_HTR") & Summary_Level == "15_Second_Interval") |
    (Dataset == "STM_s_LTR" & Summary_Level == "15_Minute_Interval")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Minute_Value = ifelse(Summary_Level == "15_Second_Interval", 0.25, 15),
    Target_Site_Date = sub("_[^_]+$", "", Grouping),
    Target_Site = sub("_[^_]+_[^_]+$", "", Grouping)
  )

effort_site_date <- base_effort %>%
  group_by(Dataset, Grouping = Target_Site_Date) %>%
  summarize(Effort_Minutes = sum(Minute_Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Summary_Level = "Site_Date")

effort_site <- base_effort %>%
  group_by(Dataset, Grouping = Target_Site) %>%
  summarize(Effort_Minutes = sum(Minute_Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Summary_Level = "Site")

effort_combined <- bind_rows(effort_site_date, effort_site)

# 3. Final merge and Macro definition identically to Table Script
df_final <- df_filtered %>%
  left_join(effort_combined, by = c("Dataset", "Summary_Level", "Grouping")) %>%
  mutate(Effort_Minutes = replace_na(Effort_Minutes, 1)) %>%
  filter(
    Summary_Level %in% c("15_Second_Interval", "1_Minute_Interval", "15_Minute_Interval") |
    (Region == "STM" & Summary_Level == "Site") |
    (Region == "PER" & Summary_Level == "Site_Date")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Summary_Level = ifelse(Summary_Level %in% c("Site", "Site_Date"), "Macro", Summary_Level)
  )

# ==========================================
# 3. GENERATE PLOTS (Pairwise Deletion & Weighted lm)
# ==========================================
plots_list <- list()

legend_categories <- c("Traditional Acoustic Index", "Unsupervised Clustering", "Source Separation", "Perch Classifier")

for (scale in names(target_scales)) {
  scale_title <- target_scales[[scale]]
  cat(sprintf("\n=== Processing scale: %s ===\n", scale))
  
  df_sub <- df_final %>% filter(Summary_Level == scale)
  
  if (nrow(df_sub) == 0) { cat("Warning: No rows found.\n"); next }

  results_list <- list()
  for (metric in metrics_list) {
    if (!metric %in% colnames(df_sub)) next
    
    df_mod <- df_sub %>% dplyr::select(SR, all_of(metric), Effort_Minutes) %>% drop_na()
    
    if (nrow(df_mod) < 3) next
    
    mod <- lm(as.formula(paste0("SR ~ `", metric, "`")), data = df_mod, weights = Effort_Minutes)
    
    r2_val <- max(0, summary(mod)$adj.r.squared)
    
    category <- "Traditional Acoustic Index"
    if (grepl("hier", metric)) category <- "Unsupervised Clustering"
    if (grepl("br_3|fr_3", metric)) category <- "Source Separation"
    if (grepl("perch", metric)) category <- "Perch Classifier"
    
    results_list[[metric]] <- data.frame(
      Raw_Name = metric, Clean_Name = clean_metric_name(metric),
      Category = category, R2 = r2_val, N_Obs = nrow(df_mod)
    )
  }
  
  if (length(results_list) > 0) {
    results_df <- bind_rows(results_list) %>%
      arrange(R2) %>% 
      mutate(
        Clean_Name = factor(Clean_Name, levels = Clean_Name),
        Bar_Label = sprintf("%.3f", R2) 
      )
    
    p_rank <- ggplot(results_df, aes(x = R2, y = Clean_Name, fill = Category)) +
      geom_col(color = "black", width = 0.8) +
      geom_richtext(aes(label = Bar_Label, hjust = -0.15), size = 5, fill = NA, label.color = NA, color = "black") +
      scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.25))) + 
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = c("Unsupervised Clustering" = "#009E73", "Source Separation" = "#0072B2", "Perch Classifier" = "#CC79A7", "Traditional Acoustic Index" = "#E69F00"),
        limits = legend_categories
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste0("Predictive Power of Metrics (", scale_title, ")"), 
        subtitle = "Ranked by Adjusted R²", 
        x = "Adjusted R²", y = NULL,
        fill = "Model Type"
      ) +
      theme_mee_bar() + 
      # Added nrow = 2 to ensure the larger text doesn't cut off at the screen edges
      guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1), order = 1, nrow = 2))
    
    plots_list[[scale]] <- p_rank
  }
}

# ==========================================
# 4. COMBINE & EXPORT
# ==========================================
if (length(plots_list) > 0) {
  cat("\nCombining plots using patchwork...\n")
  
  valid_plots <- Filter(Negate(is.null), plots_list)
  
  # Ensure the plots are generated in the exact order requested
  if (all(names(target_scales) %in% names(valid_plots))) {
    valid_plots <- valid_plots[names(target_scales)]
  }
  
  # Switched to a flat wrap_plots layout. This completely avoids nested patchwork layers 
  # and ensures guides='collect' merges everything properly into a single legend.
  combined_plot <- wrap_plots(valid_plots, ncol = 2) + 
    plot_layout(guides = 'collect') & 
    theme(
      legend.position = 'bottom',
      legend.box.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0) # Gives breathing room above the legend
    )

  output_path <- paste0(output_dir, "Figure4_Combined_Resolutions_R2_2.png")
  ggsave(output_path, combined_plot, width = 20, height = 22, dpi = 300)
  cat("Saved Combined Plot PNG to", output_path, "\n")
}
```
