```{r}
    core <- gsub("^[bf]r_", "", raw_name)
    core <- gsub("_avg", " (Avg)", core)
    core <- gsub("_sum", " (Sum)", core)
    core <- gsub("surface_roughness", "Surface Roughness", core)
    core <- gsub("spectral_snr", "Spectral SNR", core)
    return(paste0(prefix, core))
  }
  return(raw_name)
}

# ==========================================
# 2. LOAD DATA & SYNC MACRO LOGIC WITH TABLE SCRIPT
# ==========================================
cat("Loading and processing master dataset...\n")
df <- read.csv(input_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
df <- df %>% mutate(across(all_of(intersect(metrics_list, colnames(df))), ~as.numeric(na_if(as.character(.), ""))))

# 1. Filter Datasets identically to Table Script
df_filtered <- df %>%
  filter(Dataset %in% base_datasets) %>%
  mutate(Region = ifelse(grepl("PER", Dataset), "PER", "STM"))

# 2. Calculate Effort Minutes identically to Table Script
base_effort <- df %>%
  filter(
    (Dataset %in% c("PER", "STM_h", "STM_s_HTR") & Summary_Level == "15_Second_Interval") |
    (Dataset == "STM_s_LTR" & Summary_Level == "15_Minute_Interval")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Minute_Value = ifelse(Summary_Level == "15_Second_Interval", 0.25, 15),
    Target_Site_Date = sub("_[^_]+$", "", Grouping),
    Target_Site = sub("_[^_]+_[^_]+$", "", Grouping)
  )

effort_site_date <- base_effort %>%
  group_by(Dataset, Grouping = Target_Site_Date) %>%
  summarize(Effort_Minutes = sum(Minute_Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Summary_Level = "Site_Date")

effort_site <- base_effort %>%
  group_by(Dataset, Grouping = Target_Site) %>%
  summarize(Effort_Minutes = sum(Minute_Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Summary_Level = "Site")

effort_combined <- bind_rows(effort_site_date, effort_site)

# 3. Final merge and Macro definition identically to Table Script
df_final <- df_filtered %>%
  left_join(effort_combined, by = c("Dataset", "Summary_Level", "Grouping")) %>%
  mutate(Effort_Minutes = replace_na(Effort_Minutes, 1)) %>%
  filter(
    Summary_Level %in% c("15_Second_Interval", "1_Minute_Interval", "15_Minute_Interval") |
    (Region == "STM" & Summary_Level == "Site") |
    (Region == "PER" & Summary_Level == "Site_Date")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Summary_Level = ifelse(Summary_Level %in% c("Site", "Site_Date"), "Macro", Summary_Level)
  )

# ==========================================
# 3. GENERATE PLOTS (Pairwise Deletion & Weighted lm)
# ==========================================
plots_list <- list()
all_results_list <- list()

legend_categories <- c("Traditional Acoustic Index", "Unsupervised Clustering")

# --- PASS 1: Calculate models to determine the global max R² ---
cat("Fitting models across all scales to synchronize X-axes...\n")
for (scale in names(target_scales)) {
  df_sub <- df_final %>% filter(Summary_Level == scale)
  if (nrow(df_sub) == 0) next
  
  for (metric in metrics_list) {
    if (!metric %in% colnames(df_sub)) next
    
    df_mod <- df_sub %>% dplyr::select(SR, all_of(metric), Effort_Minutes) %>% drop_na()
    if (nrow(df_mod) < 3) next
    
    mod <- lm(as.formula(paste0("SR ~ `", metric, "`")), data = df_mod, weights = Effort_Minutes)
    r2_val <- max(0, summary(mod)$adj.r.squared)
    
    category <- "Traditional Acoustic Index"
    if (grepl("hier", metric)) category <- "Unsupervised Clustering"
    
    all_results_list[[length(all_results_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      Scale = scale,
      Raw_Name = metric, Clean_Name = clean_metric_name(metric),
      Category = category, R2 = r2_val, N_Obs = nrow(df_mod)
    )
  }
}

all_results_df <- bind_rows(all_results_list)

# Find global maximum R² to lock the axis limits across all subplots
global_max_r2 <- max(all_results_df$R2, na.rm = TRUE)

# --- PASS 2: Generate the plots with standardized scaling ---
for (scale in names(target_scales)) {
  scale_title <- target_scales[[scale]]
  cat(sprintf("\n=== Generating plot for scale: %s ===\n", scale))
  
  results_df <- all_results_df %>% filter(Scale == scale)
  
  if (nrow(results_df) > 0) {
    results_df <- results_df %>%
      arrange(R2) %>% 
      mutate(
        Clean_Name = factor(Clean_Name, levels = Clean_Name),
        Bar_Label = sprintf("%.3f", R2) 
      )
    
    p_rank <- ggplot(results_df, aes(x = R2, y = Clean_Name, fill = Category)) +
      geom_col(color = "black", width = 0.8) +
      geom_richtext(aes(label = Bar_Label, hjust = -0.15), size = 6, fill = NA, label.color = NA, face = "bold", color = "black") +
      scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, global_max_r2), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.20))) + 
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = c("Unsupervised Clustering" = "#009E73", "Traditional Acoustic Index" = "#E69F00"),
        limits = legend_categories
      ) +
      labs(
        title = scale_title,  
        subtitle = "Ranked by Adjusted R²", 
        x = "Adjusted R²", y = NULL,
        fill = "Metric Type"
      ) +
      theme_mee_bar() + 
      # explicitly centering title alongside keys
      guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1), order = 1, nrow = 1, title.position = "left", title.vjust = 0.5))
    
    plots_list[[scale]] <- p_rank
  }
}

# ==========================================
# 4. COMBINE & EXPORT
# ==========================================
if (length(plots_list) > 0) {
  cat("\nCombining plots using patchwork...\n")
  
  valid_plots <- Filter(Negate(is.null), plots_list)
  
  if (all(names(target_scales) %in% names(valid_plots))) {
    valid_plots <- valid_plots[names(target_scales)]
  }
  
  combined_plot <- wrap_plots(valid_plots, ncol = 2) + 
    plot_layout(guides = 'collect') & 
    theme(
      legend.position = 'bottom',
      legend.direction = 'horizontal', 
      legend.justification = c(0.5, 0.5), # Hard-locks the center anchor point
      legend.box.just = 'center',         
      legend.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 0, b = 10, l = 0) # Removed side margins to prevent invisible shoves
    )

  # Display the plot directly in the R session viewer
  print(combined_plot)

  output_path <- paste0(output_dir, "Figure4_Combined_Resolutions_R2_noPerch.png")
  
  ggsave(output_path, combined_plot, width = 26, height = 22, dpi = 300)
  cat("Saved Combined Plot PNG to", output_path, "\n")
}
```
